e.title: 巨灾建模分析师
e.summary: 用概率与仿真建模量化自然灾害/巨灾风险，支撑再保险定价与资本。
e.summary_en: Quantifies natural-catastrophe risk with probabilistic simulation to support reinsurance pricing and capital.
e.body: 巨灾建模分析师用 [[monte-carlo]]、[[extreme-value-theory]]、[[probability-distribution]] 量化巨灾风险，支撑 [[reinsurance]] 与 [[insurance-linked-securities]] 定价。
e.body_en: Catastrophe modellers quantify catastrophe risk with Monte Carlo, extreme-value theory and loss distributions, supporting reinsurance and ILS pricing.
e.body_hk: 巨災建模分析師用 [[monte-carlo]]、[[extreme-value-theory]]、[[probability-distribution]] 量化巨災風險，支撐 [[reinsurance]] 與 [[insurance-linked-securities]] 定價。
e.summary_hk: 用概率與仿真建模量化自然災害/巨災風險，支撐再保險定價與資本。
